name: AI/BI Sales Pipeline Review
narrative:
You're the VP of Sales at a global beauty brand, and it's the middle of Q2 2026. The one question that matters: are we going to hit the company-wide revenue target? The data that could answer it is scattered across Salesforce, the ERP, Finance and the product catalog — so Databricks pulls it together, and the AI forecast projects landing at ~$33M against a ~$21.5M target.

Ask Genie why the quarter is surging and it points to one thing: the new Fragrance line that launched in EMEA on May 4, with retailers stocking it fast. It's a quick end-to-end AI/BI story — synthetic data, a governed metric view, an AI/BI dashboard with AI_FORECAST, and Genie — where beating the number traces cleanly to one region and one product line.
